It’s time to build your very own Battle Wagon swarming with weapons - select, name and train your crew members, and tactically challenge enemy factions in the unforgiving Badlands.

notes.title: Survival Tips For Your Next Crew Experience
notes.content:
Hello! It’s Jon from Runner Duck here. Badlands Crew is out next week, 28th April! Thank you for all your support so far. It’s been a big project for us, and we’re really excited that you’ll all finally be able to play it!

As it’s now close to the game’s release, I thought we should write a different kind of news post, and give you a few little tips and tricks which will help you out along your way in the Badlands.

USE THE MIDDLE-CLICK SHORTCUT MENU
One of the new features in Badlands Crew is the middle-click shortcut menu. With a crew member selected, middle click somewhere on the screen. The shortcut popup menu will appear. It has shortcuts for common actions, such as sending crew to other stations, attacking enemy boarders, or repairing broken systems. This is a great way to quickly do common actions (e.g. sending a crew member to a rejuvenator to heal, or quickly sending someone to repair the engine). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/187ca3739a5af2a967b5d5d817318bd8629f8795.jpgThe middle-click shortcut menu

This works especially well for Badlands Crew, as unlike our previous games, your vehicle may have multiple rejuvenators, and loads of turrets. Don’t forget to try it out, and hopefully it’ll bring your command of your crew to a new level!

RE-BIND YOUR KEYS IF YOU DON'T GET ALONG WITH THE DEFAULTS
We’ve had a lot of back and forth on what the default keyboard controls should be. We’ve set them to what we think will be the most consistent throughout the title, and give you the best chance of survival long-term. However, some players will probably prefer to remap their vehicle nudge/speed adjustment inputs to WASD. This is fine! Please do this if you find it easier or more natural.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/49a16032c7c69c9f46ce2a657d8b4750927987cf.jpgThe control rebinding options

Control rebinding options can be found in the options menu. There are also options for axis inversion.

USE 'SLOW TIME' WHENEVER YOU'RE UNDER PRESSURE
Things can get intense quickly in the Badlands. If things aren’t going so well, you can use ‘Slow Time’ to give yourself a bit of time to get all your problems sorted. By default ‘Slow Time’ is bound to the Shift key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/895d04f9ecafb6fc0eaa57bb3caefa7d7a084270.jpgThe ‘Slow Time’ shortcut (Top-Left Corner of the UI)

Don’t forget to use ‘Slow Time’ - it really can give you the time you need to save your crew and your Battle Wagon.

UPGRADE YOUR VEHICLE'S FUEL CAPACITY EARLY
There’s nothing worse than running out of fuel in the middle of the Badlands. I would recommend adding an ‘auxiliary fuel tank’ to your vehicle as soon as you unlock it. As the game progresses, and you are able to, I’d recommend adding a couple more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/e65bb948a3bb723478604b66dc85e814fd33d3bc.jpgAn auxiliary fuel tank being added to a vehicle in the garage

DON'Y GET EATEN BY A SANDWORM
Don’t get eaten by a sandworm. If your vehicle sits idle for too long, there’s a chance a sandworm will snap it up. Repair your engine, get someone in the driving seat, and get moving!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/36f546282f3e5b962e1f3a197c328f8a654323ec.jpgA sandworm about to eat a Battle Wagon

If you start seeing a sandworm rising up from the ground around you… stay calm, and try to escape through the gaps!

USE ABILITIES (USE THEM ALOT)
If you’re not using your crew’s Abilities, you’re not getting the most out of them! It can be easy to forget you have them in the heat of battle, so use ‘Slow Time’ too if you need to! Using your crew’s Abilities strategically can make the difference between success and failure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/40874abbc1220e400bb523c9fac3ce87e4f740bc.jpgThe ‘Swerve’ ability being used

If things are intense, get your driver to use ‘Swerve’ - enemies will have a harder time aiming at you, and this can buy you some time…

LOOK OUT FOR OPTIONAL OBJECTIVES
There’s loads to discover in the Badlands. Crew at your Command Station can be used to spot Optional Objectives. Of course, be careful not to get in over your head - if you’re low on fuel, or your crew are in poor health, then perhaps it’s best to stay on mission!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/1f3de7339084036ff6c0203b095b11965c36d5d9.jpgA cache bunker containing some blueprints

Finding relics around the Badlands will reward you with additional Blueprints, giving you more options for your Battle Wagon and your crew’s gear.

USE ESCAPE DEVICES TO SAVE YOUR CREW
If it looks like you’re not going to get back to base in one piece, but you want to save some of your crew: use an Escape Device. It’s not always worth battling on - escape, and live to fight another day! Unlike Bomber Crew, crewmates who use an Escape Device will always survive (however, they may not always return to base instantly, and might need to be rescued in a subsequent mission).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/63423b9411f12df3e92f6fa75e5ab2f1d5119811.jpgAn escape device on a Battle Wagon

UPGRADE YOUR CREW & GARAGE FACILITIES
Upgrading your Crew & Garage facilities will lessen the blow of losing your crew or vehicle, so it’s definitely a good idea to remember to do this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/4c506e331abc73c4683a7b6f894d7c989a78a257.jpgUpgrading Crew Facilities 

You can upgrade your Crew facilities to increase the starting level of new recruits.
You can also upgrade your Garage facilities so that more of your Battle Wagon is salvaged (for free) when it is lost.

THERE'S MORE TO LEARN!
There’s even more to learn than I’ve written here… but hopefully these tips will help you get off to a good start! The Badlands is a dangerous place. You will lose crewmates, you will fail missions… but I hope that ultimately you will triumph. We’re all looking forward to the game’s launch on Monday. See you then!

TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE BUNDLES!
Our last tip applies IRL! If you own Bomber Crew and/or Space Crew, you'll get an extra discount when Badlands Crew launches, so make sure to take advantage of stacking launch and bundle discounts!

– Jon, Dave, Joe, Greg (Runner Duck)

notes.title: Development Update – Enemy Faction Spotlight: The Gun Nutz
notes.content:
Hello, Dave from Runner Duck here! I wanted to complete our series of posts about the enemy factions you’ll face in Badlands Crew with a look at ‘The Gun Nutz’…

To the South East of the starting area of Home Plateau lies the red eroded desert of the Lower Badlands, where you’ll run into The Gun Nutz patrolling its valleys and canyons.

The Gun Nutz are descendants of a community of preppers who sprung into action as society crumbled,
gleefully raiding army equipment storage sites, claiming the vast majority of conventional firearms and military vehicles in the land.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/6b96d8183a6651ed46f5157e6b82c88a0e5bafff.jpgA heavily armed Gun Nutz patrol harassing an ambushed Battle Wagon

Their commander in chief is the ruthless disciplinarian, Major Krank; as brutal to his own subordinates as he is to his enemies. Rumours abound that during his raids on military storage sites, he stumbled upon the last viable nuclear warhead in existence, which he wields to cow any potential challengers into submission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/c22ac2c608fa2bd63d6c38e7d8fd55bcedbb1717.jpgEarly Concept Art for the Gun Nutz Faction’s Warlord (Major Krank), Symbol and crew characters

As for vehicles, The Gun Nutz bring to bear a range of military rides including jeeps, hummers, MRAPs, pickups and half tracks. With their ready-made fleet of piercing and blast damage resistant war machines, it’s wise to prepare carefully before confronting their patrols! Perhaps try ‘turning up the heat’ on them ;).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/8b0f176f2e343c9fcaa6a97d19b5a15cb49d0f56.jpgThe Gun Nutz’ fleet of military vehicles in our ‘Virtual Parking Lot’.

The Gun Nutz’ armoury comprises a range of lethal conventional weapons, including machine guns, rifles, shotguns and grenade launchers. They have guns that are effective from close to long range, so keep those heads on a swivel!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/44ac4a228078bd88558e940ace5f9b81ba3c410b.pngL-R: A good ol’ 50 cal, a water-cooled electric drive ‘Scattermaster’ auto shotgun, ‘Doomster’ sawn off shotgun

Time for me to get back to the finishing touches on the project; it's been a long road, but now we’re just one week from release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078230/Badlands_Crew/

Thanks for reading!
Dave

notes.title: Join The Crew During Next Fest
notes.content:

We’re super excited to announce that a demo for the next game in the franchise, Badlands Crew, will officially be heading to Steam’s Next Fest this February, with the full game releasing in Spring 2025!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402770/Badlands_Crew_Demo

Buckle up, and start revving those engines, because next month you’ll be able to experience the latest evolution in the Crew series. Here’s what to expect in the demo during Next Fest...

UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY
You’ll be able to dive into the all-new vehicle customisation and get your creative juices flowing as you build an awesome Battle Wagon worthy of dominating death-defying enemy factions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/8c61c3bd45ca16a54109cc59db02f50eb8562d44.png

ASSEMBLE YOUR CREW
Get an early look at the dynamic roles, skills and abilities of your crew, and start to discover worthy combinations that are sure to bring success on your ventures throughout the Badlands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/18f5a9da9611e4d31f0997e2be6054c812d7bd95.png

Get hands-on with the advanced combat system; steer your beast of a Battle Wagon freely across the desert while you navigate your crew meticulously in high-octane battles against enemy vehicles. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/04f3f52f96798b6fe1c954c096f8e861b1d13ca9.jpg

EXPLORE THE CITADEL
Take some time out to listen to the resident Citadel band, The Wingnuts. Admire your late Crew’s valiant efforts at the shrine and recruit new members to adventure the Badlands with. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301076/82a3a18ae13aca7863d6de68a8ddcb3140e4772a.gif

Thanks for the support, we really appreciate you checking out Badlands and we hope you’re excited for the demo. Make sure to wishlist the game today to make sure you’re one of the first people to find out when the demo is live and when the full game is released later this year!

Jon, Dave, Joe & Greg.

With deep and dynamic vehicle customization, build your own beast of a battle wagon ready to head out into the carnage and succeed in your voyage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/f84c1a27baee0618905f84a86afdea4bee91d747.gif

Transform your rag-tag crew of skill-less grunts into a legendary unit of elite road warriors – with an array of skills, abilities and perks to choose from to suit your unique playstyle.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/e430979d41041c559542798feecaa73936470503.gif

Combat requires commanders to multitask under immense pressure. Think quickly on your feet and manage your crew individually in the heat of battle to man guns, repair vehicle components, heal injured crewmates and repel boarders. Drive and navigate to avoid environmental hazards such as sandstorms, volcanic eruptions and giant sandworms whilst fighting off waves of enemy combatants. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/f0fd917fd430b49cafdf5ec654a8139e7cb1ab65.gif

The Badlands is a vast desert landscape, filled with strongholds and outposts to overcome on your journey. Your decisions change the campaign map as faction influence declines and grows based on the outcome of your battles. Smart decision-making within the safety of The Citadel when planning routes, customizing vehicles and training your crew is just as important as critical calls made during the heat of battle. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/04a1c4da79d9aa5daec03e38fe8417a689eadd11.gif

And most of all, go head-to-head with the wild enemy factions that roam the Badlands. The Gun Nutz, Pyros, Vultures and Klowns are each led by a crazed warlord boss. Going head-to-head to defeat them in combat will require skill and planning as each faction has their own unique weaponry and combat tactics. You will need to adapt your strategies, your battle wagon build and your crew’s skills to succeed! 

Well, what are you waiting for? Wishlist now and get ready for your first mission into the treacherous Badlands!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/99aab8b35a5fe71ae11f507811048540821996b3.gif

notes.title: Just like Space Crew, WDC is on a mission! 🐳
notes.content:
We are thrilled to be able to support WDC in this year's Jingle Jam!

WDC has been incredibly lucky to be a Jingle Jam featured charity since 2016 raising over £1.6 million for our vital work to protect whales and dolphins across the globe from the many threats they face. 

The incredible support from the generous and passionate Jingle Jam community has had a huge impact on several key areas of our work.  

Jingle Jam 2021 helped to fund our innovative project to reduce entanglements of whales here in the UK, and urgent work within the Faroes to end the cruel dolphin hunts. 

This year we are so excited to share that we are planning to use the funds raised from Jingle Jam 2022 to support our work in Scotland, with three vital projects: 

Shorewatch Expansion  
Shorewatch is WDC’s citizen science programme aimed at inspiring love and understanding for whales and dolphins by collating sightings of whales, dolphins and porpoises from the Scottish coast. We will support more young adults (18+) to participate in the Shorewatch programme and engage with nature, inspiring them to learn about the ocean and champion better protection for whales, dolphins and the planet. 
[previewyoutube=KxB2I19zj4E;full][/previewyoutube]

Scottish Dolphin Centre educational exhibition upgrade  
Enhance our exhibitions with interactive displays and experiences to provide more exciting educational opportunities for visitors as well as encouraging support for our ongoing campaigns. We will also make the exhibition more accessible, thus allowing a wider diversity of children and people of all ages to enjoy and learn about whales and dolphins, and how to better protect the ocean and the planet. 
[previewyoutube=avYJhLbLd7Y;full][/previewyoutube]


Tackling chemical pollution in Scottish waters  
Chemical pollution is devastating the ocean and its inhabitants and has put an entire population of orcas living in Scottish waters at risk of extinction. WDC will undertake research and develop a campaign to drive positive changes to chemical legislation to protect whales and dolphins and stop species from becoming extinct. 
[previewyoutube=uj_NySIEXms;full][/previewyoutube] 

  

Find out more here:  

WDC: https://uk.whales.org/ 

Jingle Jam 2022: https://www.jinglejam.co.uk/

notes.title: Space Crew Update 1.2 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We’re happy to announce that the latest update to Space Crew is now available!

This time, we’ve focused on a few areas that have been highlighted in the great feedback we’ve received from the community.

Firstly, we’ve added a range of new Events and Encounters to punctuate missions with more variety and surprises. In addition to this, the Comms Station has received upgrades in the form of a new Hacking Function and Mission Map.

You’ll have more control during combat in the form of the new Custom Waypoint and Prioritise Target functions accessible when in Tagging Mode.

Lastly, we’ve added MK3 Weapon pods to complete that ultimate loadout.

There are also a few minor improvements and additions, which we’ve listed below.

Once more, thanks for all your feedback and suggestions, they’ve been enormously helpful to us as we work to enhance the game.

We hope you jump back in and enjoy these new features and content, and please do continue to let us know what you think!

Dave, Jon, Joe & Greg (Our new team member!)
Runner Duck

Release Notes:

New Events and Encounters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/2e659c65b00e2df8b81d2fb3b42559fa69fb3933.jpg
You’ll encounter cosmic phenomena such as Ion Storms that may cause intermittent power outages (We’ve added the ability to quickly repair the effects of EMP on the ship’s reactor, so this can be combatted).

You’ll be confronted with Meteor Showers that bombard your shields and hull, and Neutrino Flares that can damage systems and spark onboard fires. You may also encounter a Passing Radioactive Comet, which will bombard your crew with radiation, calling for a hasty escape from the sector.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/6d752c447293c40dd22df9bfc3b507c96b82179e.jpg
Strange Phasmid Artifacts may be encountered, such as the Phasmid Beacon, which will summon Phasmid forces if not hacked in time. Another hackable artefact is the Phasmid Comms Relay, which will broadcast a self-destruct signal to all enemy ships in the sector if you can keep your cool and successfully hack it while under attack.

Every so often, you may find a discarded Phasmid Wormhole Drive floating in space. Once hacked, these can provide a useful shortcut through the mission. Be careful, as these drives are unstable, and you may end up stuck in the wormhole for a duration, along with some very annoyed Phasmids!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/dca866b88d36fe8a4ed93eee021793ffd6269d26.jpg
The Phasmids have been busy establishing more outposts around the Galaxies; take out their shield generators and hit their reactors hard to obliterate them.

And be wary of the new Phasmid Frigates, which have been tasked with scanning sectors for UDF craft, ready to jump in and attack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/c31468b21cd7fd67afff9fba5b49c2d5bb080c84.jpg
UDF Aid Stations will provide much-needed respite - simply land at them to replenish your crew’s health and recharge your med bay. But be on your guard, some of these outposts have been overrun by Phasmid troops!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/a86a2e2069434589704ff274a8e262a9911316a6.jpg
As the war for the fate of Earth rages on, you’ll encounter Ongoing Space Battles that require your assistance, and plenty of debris left in their aftermath.

Custom Waypoints

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/7e776ce8885a7b54cae46da1acedd56f644f46c0.jpg
You now have more control over the heading of your ship, thanks to the Custom Waypoint feature. Just enter Tagging Mode and follow the prompt to point your ship in the desired direction. This is extra useful for ensuring your gunners have the best angle on their targets.

Prioritise Targets

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/d0d0daa5900268249271d28e50f0cd9742f8d81a.jpg
Another new feature accessible in Tagging Mode allows you to specify a tagged fighter as the priority target. Use this to take out key threats such as Phasmid Docking Craft and Drone Carriers.

‘Return Crew to Stations’ shortcut Panel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/6be1d7e97a91fb271302a8773196eba70177e0f8.jpg
A handy set of shortcuts that allow you to quickly get your crew organised in a crisis.
There are options to Return Idle crew who are not engaged in an action to the nearest appropriate station, Return All crew to the nearest appropriate station even if they’re busy, and the option to Save Stations for all crew and then Return to Saved to get everyone back into their saved seats.

Comms Station Hacking Function

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/44035f5b4ec36c19b90c47f0323805e84fc1b5fa.jpg
Larger enemies and some artefacts can now be hacked! Simply tag the hacking marker to get in range, then initiate hacking via the Comms Station. You’ll need to tap out the correct sequence of symbols to successfully complete the hack. The required code may be received from the target during the hack, or in some instances be found marked on the target object. Codes can also be found and stored by scanning Phasmid Code Banks which may be found floating around in space - these will make hacking a breeze.

Comms Station Mission Map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/2f10c1cfa02daa9ad192520167bcb9a10f1cb6bb.jpg
‘Are we there yet?’
You can now open a map of the available sectors during a mission. While the map is open, the action is paused to give you some time to get your bearings.

Mark 3 Weapon Pods

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/87830c0bff0cebf5379df52d63101571e41b63a3.jpg
We’ve added top-tier versions of the Missile Launcher, Autocannon HE, Particle Beam, Railgun (this one’s a doozy!) and their combo variants.

Minor Fixes and Improvements

Improved impact effects when the most effective weapon type is used on a target. (e.g. Plasma Cannon vs Shields, Missiles vs Armour).
Sectors in the briefing room map can now be highlighted to show more information.
The ship’s reactor can now be repaired to recover from an EMP burst sooner.
Ship’s Reactor status UI now shows an EMP effect.
A button to access the Space Crew Discord server added to the Main Menu.
Low Oxygen damage no longer affects crew in the med bay.
Added an option to change the volume of the crew ‘Jabber’.
Extended the range of camera movement sensitivity for controllers.
Prevented weapons from firing during switching.
Added flash effect for enemies jumping into the sector.

notes.title: 1.2 Update Progress
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Just a quick update to let you all know that we're still hard at work on the next update to Space Crew.

Amongst other smaller bug fixes and improvements, this update will include a range of new random events to keep your crew on their toes as they go about their missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/c199cf4b5c11aae0e5023eca21433bc6b2f0b8d9.jpg

You'll encounter strange Phasmid artefacts, fearsome enemy Frigates, the respite of UDF Aid Stations and possibly a wormhole shortcut or two!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/c6c65d7cab5a2e4e7228e189374e9bc8b2887fe9.jpg

The Comms station will receive a new Hacking function, allowing your crew to activate certain alien objects, and even disable systems of larger enemy craft and structures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/6c3435e5fb699f9444e98d241f0ed064cd31742c.jpg

While in Targeting Mode, it will now be possible to set a custom waypoint to follow and to choose a tagged enemy as a priority target for your gunners.

There will be many more improvements including more Mark 3 weapons, and a handy panel with options to quickly get all your crew to return to their stations.

We'll publish a full list of changes closer to this update's release.
In the meantime, we're working hard to get this update into your hands as soon as possible.

Until then, thanks for playing!

Dave, Jon & Joe
Runner Duck

notes.title: Space Crew 1.1 Update is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello!

After a busy week with our noses to the grindstone, we're pleased to get the first update to Space Crew into your hands!

We've taken all of your valuable feedback on board and have set out to address as many issues as possible, as quickly and carefully as possible; so that everyone can continue their saved games with the benefit of additional options and fixes.

We're continuing to read all of your comments, which are extremely useful in helping us plan for future improvements, so once again, thank you and please feel free to keep them coming!

Update release notes are below, we hope you enjoy playing!

Dave, Jon & Joe
Runner Duck

Release Notes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/332bccab163612fb8b90555b46d372430698cf28.jpg

Added ‘Difficulty Adjustment’ options

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/653f9147c7737efe7b6df8fe6b9fccb9807b0f62.jpg
(Accessible from a button in the Mess Hall)

Tagging Mode:
 Classic:
(Default mode).
 Semi-automatic:
Enemies are automatically tagged as long as a crew member is at the Comms Station. If this station is unmanned, enemies must be tagged manually.
 Automatic:
Enemies are always tagged automatically.

Difficulty:
 Challenging:
(Default Mode)
 Casual:
For players looking for a more laid-back experience.
 Panic Stations!:
An additional, higher difficulty setting for players who relish a real challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/281b230737246d017e65eb7fb2932fb4db364f04.jpg
Crew Size:
 Classic:
(Default mode - six crew members)
 Increased:
An option to recruit a seventh crew member to serve as an additional gunner.

(The ship now has the option of installing up to seven escape pods).

(If starting a new game without skipping the tutorials, the seventh crew member is recruitable after the second mission).

Slow Time:
 Classic:
(Default mode - The duration that time can be slowed down for is limited, and replenishes gradually).
 Off:
For players who are always comfortable with making fast-paced decisions.
 Unlimited:
For players who prefer to have the option of some extra thinking time whenever things get intense.


Minor changes to ease some more frustrating situations and other quality of life fixes:


 Equipment rack items are refunded with 100% of their value, meaning there is no penalty for switching items to a different rack.
 Gunners with high accuracy are more likely to land their shots on enemies.
 Replacement crew members’ levels increased slightly.
 Phasmid Champions stick around for longer in ‘Defeat Champion’ missions.
 Locked Gear and Upgrade items are now shown in the Crew Gear and Spacecraft screens. When selected, they display the required Research Points to unlock them.
 Additional Custom Livery Slots - there are now 8 slots in which to save your custom designs.
 New Game - Skip Tutorial option on Main Menu. This starts a new game but skips the first couple of tutorial missions.
 Player’s shields begin recharging slightly sooner after they have been depleted.
 Player's shields begin recharging from 25% when they recover from 0%, to help mitigate them breaking immediately.
 Equipment jettisoned from the ship in sectors near the black hole will be drawn into it.
 Added a warning popup with details of the dangers of black holes when first encountering them.
 Missile launcher fire rate is slower, but each missile deals more damage and homing accuracy is slightly improved.
 Crew ‘Phase Pistol’ holster item damage is buffed.
 Power loss to energy weapons, shield recharger and gravity generator is made clearer by changing their lights to red.
 An audible alarm now sounds when the Oxygen Generator is out of action.
 Fix for ‘4’ key on AZERTY keyboards.

notes.title: Upcoming Update Progress
notes.content:
Hi All,

We've been reading all the great feedback you've taken the time to send our way.
Jon, Joe and myself have been working hard to get the first update out to you.

Here's an overview of what's included in our first batch of changes to Space Crew:

Difficulty

We've made a range of adjustments that should help alleviate some of the more frustrating situations during missions, such as improving the chance of gunners landing their shots on enemies, shield recharging being less hampered by taking hits, and many other adjustments.

We've also added a range of new difficulty options, so you can find a balance that suits the challenge you're looking for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/332bccab163612fb8b90555b46d372430698cf28.jpg

We've added a 'Casual' difficulty setting for those looking for a less bumpy ride, and a 'Panic Stations!' mode for those who are breezing through the game currently and want more of a challenge.

You'll also be able to dispense with tagging enemies if its not your thing, with the Automatic Tagging modes, where the game will tag enemies automatically, so you can focus on managing your crew.

There is an option to either switch off, or give yourself Unlimited Slow Time, so you can get some more time to think in the heat of battle.

The final option in these settings is...

Increased Crew Size

You can choose to recruit a seventh crew member aboard, to serve as an additional gunner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/281b230737246d017e65eb7fb2932fb4db364f04.jpg

There are many other smaller changes, which we will provide more info on in the release notes.

All three of us are working our hardest to get this update tested and available to you as soon as we possibly can.

In the meantime, thanks for playing, thanks for your patience, and our sincerest thanks for supporting us with your feedback and suggestions!

Dave, Jon & Joe.
Runner Duck

notes.title: Space Crew Tips & Tricks
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support of Space Crew so far! We really appreciate all your feedback, and it's great to see so many of you playing already.

It's dangerous out there in space, so we'd like to share some tips & tricks you can use to make your ride a little (or a lot) more comfortable.

Even in the Runner Duck team, we all use very different approaches when playing through the game, so please feel free to share your own in our forums, We'd be really interested to know what's worked for everyone playing the game so far!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38038049/5e317e90a432394f1fcde3bf4a3004feba29681e.gif

 Use your abilities
Crew abilities are essential. If your ship is taking a hammering, use 'Evasive Piloting'. You can also use this to prevent a docking ship from being able to line up, to buy you some time. Got a few fires or repairs to do, but there's a lot going on? Try using 'Stealth Mode' to give yourself some time. Use your engineer's "boost" the reactor and put more energy in to your shields or weapons!

 Prioritise repairs
Repair your engines (don't forget a space suit!), oxygen generator and reactor as soon as you can!

 Be prepared for boarders
Maybe you've seen the ship coming in the distance? Maybe you've heard its docking sound? Get someone ready in advance, and you'll be rid of those Phasmid boarders before they can even start to cause any chaos.

Equip your ship with some thought
Make sure you've got enough med kits! Be sure phase rifles and extinguishers are placed near where you'll need them.

 Get your Security Officer on the guns
Either the front gun, allowing quick access to the security station (for shield replenishing or going in to stealth mode), or the middle gun with a phase rifle nearby for taking out Phasmids.

 A fourth gunner
Want someone else on the guns, too? Your engineer or comms officer are both strong candidates for this. If you're mostly using non-energy weapons, your Engineer can work well. If you're using energy weapons, you may want to have your Engineer using their "boost" skill to allow you to put more power in to your weapons. Or, you can move your Comms Officer to the front gun, allowing them to quickly hop back to their own station for route planning.

 Don't worry if you fail
Replacement crew & ships improve as you go through the game, so you'll never be left with total rubbish - but it may be wise to take on a few low risk missions if you lose everyone.

 Escape pods
Put them on your ship and use them. If everything's gone wrong, there's a good chance of recovery (plus getting the XP gathered so far in the mission). This may also open up rescue missions for crew that don't return immediately.

 Take the safest route
If you're not confident yet, take the safest route.

Take the fastest route... at your own risk 
OK, you've got a decent crew, a decent ship... you know your abilities and skills like the back of your hand. Maybe your crew could do with a bit more combat experience? Go fast!

 Go home
Don't be afraid to "Abort" the mission (abort button is on the Captain's station). Med bay gauge empty? Out of med packs? Don't think you'll survive another battle? Try to go home - you'll get the XP you got so far, and keep your ship and crew.

 Alien artifacts & cargo pods
You can scan or retrieve these for some extra spending resources... but, be careful - perhaps the Phasmids are tracking them...?

 Repairing engines
Remember a space suit. Oh, and don't use evasive piloting while your crew member is trying to balance on the engines (If you do, though, you can always tractor beam them back in!).

And don't forget: our brand new trailer has five things to help you void complete crew annihilation!

notes.title: Space Crew to launch October 15th on Steam
notes.content:
It’s almost time to don your space suit and ascend to the stars as Space Crew, the sci-fi sequel to the sandbox hit Bomber Crew, will launch on 15th October worldwide.


Space Crew features the same compelling gameplay loop as its beloved predecessor with players controlling the moment-to-moment actions of their carefully selected, fully customisable crew. Their mission? To boldly go where no space crew has gone before and fight off an alien menace that threatens to eradicate humanity!

[previewyoutube=u2r3BVhhyLA;full]YT[/previewyoutube]
In Space Crew, we’ve expanded the ‘Bomber Crew’ formula into the final frontier, so players can send their customised ship and crew to boldly go and brave the many hazards of space combat. We were absolutely blown away by the response to our demo from fans earlier this year. We can't wait to put the full game into your hands so we can see what adventures you undertake.
